events.name: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford made up for some mistakes with three touchdown passes, including one to Calvin Johnson, to help the Detroit Lions score 37 straight points after an awful start to beat the Green Bay Packers 40-10 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions get first Thanksgiving win in 10 years

headlines.description: DeMarco Murray ran for three touchdowns, backup Lance Dunbar had a career-high 82 yards rushing and the Dallas Cowboys overcame Oakland's fumble return for a score on the opening kickoff to beat the Raiders 31-24 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray's 3 TDs rally Cowboys past Raiders

headlines.description: Justin Tucker kicked five field goals, and the Baltimore Ravens stopped a 2-point conversion with 1:03 left to survive a comeback bid by the Pittsburgh Steelers and escape with a 22-20 victory Thursday night.
Cecil Shorts caught a 20-yard touchdown pass from Chad Henne with 40 seconds left, rallying the Jacksonville Jaguars to a 32-28 win over the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henne fuels Jaguars' late rally past Browns

headlines.description: Adam Vinatieri tied a career high with five field goals and Donald Brown scored on a 4-yard touchdown run with 1:56 left Sunday, giving the Colts a 22-14 victory over Tennessee.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts hold off Titans to extend AFC South lead

headlines.description: Blair Walsh's 34-yard field goal with 1:43 left in overtime gave the Minnesota Vikings a 23-20 victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday after both teams missed kicks in the extra period.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson, Vikings outlast Bears in overtime

events.name: Miami Dolphins at New York Jets

headlines.description: Ryan Tannehill threw for 331 yards and two touchdowns, leading Miami to a 23-3 victory over the listless New York Jets on Sunday that kept the Dolphins' playoff hopes alive.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins whip Jets to remain in playoff hunt

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw three touchdown passes and the Philadelphia Eagles held on for a 24-21 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles throws 3 TDs as Eagles hold off Cards

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 263 yards and two touchdowns and ran for another score, and the Carolina Panthers defeated Tampa Bay 27-6 Sunday for a franchise-record eighth straight regular-season victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers cruise to 8th straight victory

events.name: New England Patriots at Houston Texans

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 371 yards and two scores, and Stephen Gostkowski made two long field goals in the fourth quarter as New England Patriots rallied for a 34-31 win over Houston.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats rally, extend Texans' skid to 10 games

headlines.description: Opportunistic Falcons beat Bills 34-31 in OT
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons win in OT to spoil Bills' Toronto game

events.name: St. Louis Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Anquan Boldin caught nine passes from Colin Kaepernick, Michael Crabtree made his long-awaited season debut six months after Achilles tendon surgery, and the San Francisco 49ers beat the St. Louis Rams 23-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Boldin's big day helps lead 49ers by Rams

events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Manning, Decker lead Broncos past Chiefs 35-28
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos top Chiefs; take control of  AFC West

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Dalton, Green lead Bengals to 17-10 win vs Bolts
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton, Green lead Bengals past Chargers

events.name: New York Giants at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Eli Manning completed 22 of 28 passes for 235 yards, and Justin Tuck had four sacks to help shut down Robert Griffin III in the second half Sunday night, leading the New York Giants to a 24-17 win over the Washington Redskins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants bottle up RG III late to top Redskins

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for 310 yards and three touchdowns, and the Seattle Seahawks became the first team to clinch a spot in the NFC playoffs with a 34-7 victory over the New Orleans Saints on Monday night.
